# Luis Enrique Góngora Ek

> Professional portfolio of Luis Enrique Góngora Ek, a Full Stack Developer focused on web, mobile, backend architecture, APIs, integrations, automation, performance, scalability, and maintainability.

## Canonical portfolio pages

- Spanish: https://legongoraek.github.io/
- English: https://legongoraek.github.io/en.html

## Core profile

Luis Enrique Góngora Ek builds scalable web and mobile systems. The portfolio highlights backend development with Django and REST APIs, frontend development with React and Vue, mobile development with React Native, database work with PostgreSQL and MySQL, integrations with external APIs, and business-process automation.

## Main technologies

- JavaScript
- React
- React Native
- Vue.js
- Electron
- Django
- Django REST Framework
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
- MySQL
- WordPress
- WooCommerce
- Linux / Ubuntu automation and middleware

## Selected projects

- Fidelyt: loyalty platform with web, backend, mobile, testing, and intranet components.
- Fidelyt Testing Playground: E2E and business-flow validation environment using Playwright.
- KYB Customs Platform: B2B KYB and customs-compliance workflow platform. https://github.com/legongoraek/kyb-customs-platform
- Query Converter AI: tool for converting, correcting, optimizing, and explaining multiple query formats.
- Dashboard Garmin Connect: activity and health metrics dashboard. https://github.com/legongoraek/dashboard-garmin
- Dashboard Crypto - Dinametra: cryptocurrency data dashboard using CoinGecko. https://github.com/legongoraek/dinametra-dashboard
- Dashboard SpaceX - Amerisa Logistics: logistics-oriented dashboard integrating external API data. https://github.com/legongoraek/amerisa-spacex-dashboard
- Medicar: healthcare-focused web platform.
- SuperListApp: web and mobile inventory-management platform.
- Horizonte Inmobiliario: real-estate website with EasyBroker integration.
- Renta lo que quieras: P2P rental marketplace with catalog, bookings, and management dashboards.
- ProBike: corporate website for a bicycle store.
- Portfolio Assistant: shared serverless conversational assistant that answers questions about experience, projects, and skills, with configurable LLM provider.
- Medular AI: modular clinical platform with longitudinal EHR, RIS/PACS radiology module, and FHIR interoperability.
- Connect to Analytics: tool for querying industrial monitoring data, historical measurements, and FFT/TWF signals. https://github.com/legongoraek/connect-to-analytics
- WhatsBot: provider-agnostic WhatsApp platform with a multi-line inbox, automations, AI agents, and human support handoff. https://whats-bot-sepia.vercel.app/
- Moments: digital invitations for weddings, quinceañeras, and events, with RSVP and guest management. https://moments-bay-omega.vercel.app/
- LicitaBot: monitoring and sector classification of public procurement notices from ComprasMX.
- MapUniversity: university benefits map with location and category search, plus administration tools. https://mapuniversity.vercel.app/
- FindMyJob: private job-search dashboard with application stages, follow-ups, analytics, and CSV export. https://find-my-job-delta.vercel.app
